cohort.shared_information: only original public fields, own selected actions and feedback; no hidden inventory/pose/map/episode oracle or external selected actions
cohort.per_role_family_continuity: selected empirical history across three seeds within same family, never across role/family; episode-local inferred occupancy resets at env.reset

hypothesis: Original-world MG38 failed to complete pickup missions because 152/152 selected drop actions faced nonempty front; test if memory of own pickup/drop public effects leads to better selection of permissible drop opportunities, freeing the action precondition for subsequent targets.

mechanism.name: public-action-effect-proxy memory, not true hidden carrying state
mechanism.selected_pickup_effect: own selected action3 when before.public.front type in 5,6,7; after.public.front type1 empty with unchanged direction
mechanism.selected_drop_effect: own selected action4 when before.public.front type1 empty; after.public.front type in 5,6,7 with unchanged direction
mechanism.inferred_occupied_proxy: true after observed selected pickup effect, false after observed selected drop effect, reset false at source env.reset. May differ from private inventory; never inspect private inventory.
mechanism.enabled_policy: inherits unchanged MG38 navigation-aware action scorer and generic engineered public-front priors. When proxy true AND current public front empty, prefer action4/drop by a bounded explicit addend 8.0; when proxy true AND before public front has pickupable object type5/6/7, penalize action3 by 8.0; otherwise identical scorer. Only exact own observed effects update proxy.
mechanism.ablated_policy: identical code, action scorer, inputs, source feedback, checkpoints and seeded history; occupancy proxy still audited but evidence-derived action overrides disabled
mechanism.explicit_engineered_priors: Object class, action3/4 and public front outcome detectors as well as original MG38 generic front object prior are hand-engineered. A pass supports a precondition-memory engineering hypothesis, not autonomous discovery of semantic rules.
mechanism.cold_checkpoint: canonical exact selected history and inferred occupancy proxy persist intra-episode, with episode-local occupancy reset on each authentic env.reset; both arms checked and compared for deterministic replay

metrics.per_role_family: actual positive original terminal goal episodes, genuine exact mission target pickup disappearance, target-anywhere/target-front opportunities, selected pickup attempts, selected drop front-empty attempts and public-confirmed successful drops, public locked door opens, action histogram and source selected count
metrics.denominators: report all selected drop attempts, before-front empty fraction, observed selected drop effects, selected front-target pickup effects, per-episode inferred proxy transitions; do not count repeated views as independent locations
metrics.replay: two full independent original-world processes with identical canonical evidence digest, no hidden state, equal 192 own-selected action caps per episode
metrics.resources: original action/observation cap matched; wall/CPU optional separate; full native child CPU/RSS and power parity unqualified

require_all: memory-enabled candidate >=1 publicly confirmed successful drop from empty-front in unfamiliar pickup family
memory-enabled exact mission target pickup effect >=1 in unfamiliar pickup families
memory-enabled positive terminal goal episodes >=2 unfamiliar pickup families including UnlockPickup or BlockedUnlockPickup
memory-enabled original positive unfamiliar goal count strictly exceeds memory-disabled matched ablation AND the MG38 and MG39B original controls
exact reproducible 132 original episodes and full genuine own-selected source hashes match across two processes

next: Even successful engineering DEV requires new independent held-out family transfer, matched computational resource controls, removal/ablation of engineered prior features and independent scientific witness before any native promotion.
